newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly higher.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open slightly higher Friday although some initial strength in LME copper on a fall in LME warehouse stocks quickly ran out of steam in London overnight.
LME copper stocks fell 2,100 tonnes to 273,675 tonnes.
After its sharp fall Thursday to three-week lows, COMEX December copper was called unchanged to up 0.40 cent a lb.
COMEX December copper traded between 88.90 and 89.70 cents on overnight ACCESS.
COMEX warehouse stocks were unchanged Thursday at 22,104 short tones.

U.S. August jobs data are due at 0830, with non-farm payrolls expected to rise 244,000 from a gain of 193,000 last month. The unemployment rate is expected to be 5.3 percent versus 5.4 pct last month, while average hourly earnings are expected to rise 0.3 pct, after a fall of 0.2 pct last month.
